introduction: Several layers of 8mm films merge to create a camera-less portrait of the filmmaker. The first layer is an 8mm orphan film from the 1970s of a woman dancing, the original box titled "woman dancing with a dog." The second layer is an 8mm found footage film that has been buried for some weeks. While covered in soil, the film emulsion has been eaten by bacteria in the ground, plus some bacteria from yeast and sugar. The third layer is an 8mm home movie that has been first decayed in soil, using the technique mentioned above, then hand-painted with ink.
